name: Notion
category_description: App node - connects to an external service API
description: Use the Notion node to automate work in Notion, and integrate Notion with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of Notion features, including getting and searching databases, creating pages, and getting users

common_issues.title: Relation property not displaying
common_issues.summary: The Notion node only supports displaying the data relation property for two-way relations. When you connect two Notion databases with a two-way relationship, you can select or filter by the relation property when working with the Notion node's Database Page resource

common_issues.title: Create toggle heading
common_issues.summary: The Notion node allows you to create headings and toggles when adding blocks to Page, Database Page, or Block resources. Creating toggleable headings isn't yet supported by the Notion node itself

common_issues.title: Handle null and empty values
common_issues.summary: You may receive a validation error when working with the Notion node if you submit fields with empty or null values. This can occur any time you populate fields from previous nodes when that data is missing
